column1: # INDEX.tsv — one row per preserved free-placement archive. Generated once from the
# files beside it and then frozen: see README.md for why this set has no generator.
# Every field except `kind` is read out of the archive itself, not out of its name.
# `kind` is read out of the archive too — from which benchmarks it contains — because
# the name does not say (README.md, "what the names do not record").
#   1 file       the archive beside this index
#   2 rev        the tree revision, from the name (bench_csv put it there)
#   3 host       the hostname, from the name; `—` where bench_csv was called untagged
#   4 cpu_model  keel-bench-cpu, the exact string the registries key on
#   6 gomaxprocs keel-bench-gomaxprocs — the free arm read the whole machine
#   7 kind       ladder (the judged benchmarks + their ceiling arm) | clock-window
